seed-001.text: Came for lunch and waited almost 40 minutes for a plate of chicken rice. Food was fine but the wait is ridiculous for a hawker stall.

seed-002.text: 排队等了半个多小时才拿到食物，中午人手明显不够。味道还可以，但等太久了。

seed-003.text: The sambal here is incredible, best I have had in the east. Auntie was so warm and even remembered my order from last time.

seed-004.text: Meja tak dilap, lengket dengan minyak. Lantai pun kotor. Makanan sedap tapi kebersihan kena jaga.

seed-005.text: 45 minutes for two plates of noodles at lunchtime. The queue was out the door and only one person was cooking. Never again on a weekday.

seed-006.text: மதிய உணவுக்கு நாற்பது நிமிடம் காத்திருக்க வேண்டியிருந்தது. உணவு நன்றாக இருந்தது, ஆனால் காத்திருப்பு நேரம் மிக அதிகம்.

seed-007.text: 周末中午来，等了差不多40分钟。厨房只有一个人在炒，队伍很长。食物没问题，就是太慢。

seed-008.text: Uncle at the stall is a legend, always cheerful even during the rush. Portions are generous and the price has not gone up in years.

seed-009.text: Harga naik lagi, sekarang lapan ringgit untuk nasi ayam biasa. Rasa okay je, tak sepadan dengan harga.

seed-010.text: Lunch service is broken. Ordered at 12:15, got my food at 1:05. Almost an hour. The staff know it is bad, they keep apologising but nothing changes.

seed-011.text: 中午12点半来，等到1点15分才有位子和食物。人手太少，一个人根本忙不过来。以后不敢午餐时间来了。

seed-012.text: மதியம் ஒரு மணிக்கு வந்தேன், உணவு வர ஐம்பது நிமிடம் ஆனது. வேலையாட்கள் போதவில்லை. உணவு சூடாக இல்லை, அவ்வளவு நேரம் காத்ததால்.

seed-013.text: Saturday lunch, waited 55 minutes. This is the third weekend in a row it has been like this. Whatever changed a month ago, please change it back.

seed-014.text: Tengah hari sangat lambat. Menunggu hampir sejam untuk mee goreng. Satu orang je masak masa lunch rush, memang tak larat.

seed-015.text: Dinner on a weeknight was a totally different experience, quick and quiet. The hor fun had great wok hei. Come after 7pm and you are fine.

seed-016.text: 阿姨人很好，服务态度一流。晚上来吃很舒服，没什么人排队。菜的味道一直都很稳定。

seed-017.text: The curry was lukewarm when it reached me, like it had been sitting out. Taste was there but I had to ask them to heat it up again.

seed-018.text: Tray return area was overflowing and nobody cleared it for the whole time I was there. Tables sticky. The food deserves a cleaner setting.

seed-019.text: நான் கோழி பிரியாணி கேட்டேன், அவர்கள் ஆட்டு பிரியாணி கொடுத்தார்கள். திரும்பக் கொடுக்க மறுத்தார்கள். கவனக்குறைவு.

seed-020.text: Bising sangat masa lunch, susah nak dengar orang bercakap. Kipas pun rosak, panas. Makanan tetap sedap macam biasa.

seed-021.text: Still the best value lunch in the neighbourhood if you come early. Was seated and eating within ten minutes at 11:15am.

seed-022.text: 份量比以前少了很多，价钱却一样。一小块鸡肉配一堆饭，吃不饱。
